name: Punchcard
description: Punched cards read in diagonal runs: every third position along the diagonal is struck through.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 24%; top: 34%; width: 52%; height: 32%; background: var(--color0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match((@x + @y) % 3 == 0) { :after { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
